summary: Tested Instagram-style share-to-user feature end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering /api/messages/share-suggestions, /api/search/users, /api/feuds/{id}/share (fan-out), /api/messages/send with shared_feud_id, and conversations preview '📎 Post condiviso'. Frontend E2E: token injection into localStorage worked; share-button on feud detail opens InAppShareSheet, search 'chat' returns chatUserB, tapping tile shows action-bar + caption input + send button, tapping send closes the sheet and posts the message, and /messages/{userId} chat screen renders msg-shared-feud-* bubbles with feud title, category chip and 'APRI IL POST' CTA. Anonymous regression verified: share button opens external ShareSheet (WhatsApp/Telegram/X/Facebook + copy-link), NOT the in-app sheet.
action_items: No action required — feature is fully functional on both backend and frontend.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4482 lines — consider splitting into feature modules (messaging, feuds, search, admin) for maintainability.

In POST /feuds/{id}/share, fan-out delegates to send_message() sequentially inside a for-loop; for large recipient_ids lists this serialises. Fine given max_length=25, but consider asyncio.gather for parallelism.

share-suggestions endpoint iterates messages (limit 5000) then does N+1 queries for replies parent lookups (line 3996 db.comments.find_one inside async for). Fine at current scale, but flag for later optimisation.
seed_data_creation: Test fixture sends 2 seed messages from chat_a → chat_b so USER_B ranks in share-suggestions. Tests also send several share fan-out messages with 'TEST_share_*' / 'TEST_fanout_*' text markers into the chat_a↔chat_b conversation — not cleaned up but easily identifiable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: InAppShareSheet + shared_feud pipeline fully verified. Testable via /app/backend/tests/test_share_to_users.py. Token injection pattern that works: `await page.evaluate(f"() => localStorage.setItem('faide_token', {json.dumps(json.dumps(token))})")` — value MUST be JSON.stringify(token) (i.e. double-quoted string) because AsyncStorage web wraps values in JSON. Then reload page. Frontend testIDs verified in DOM: share-button, share-search-input, share-user-{uid}, share-action-bar, share-caption-input, share-send-btn, share-in-app-close, share-open-external, msg-shared-feud-{msg_id}.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification task, not a bug fix.
